sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — Help page: FastHome Delivery
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Thank you for shopping with FastHome! Here is how to get help.

Late orders: first, check the delivery status on our website. You need your order number. If your order is more than three days late, please contact customer service.

Damaged products: if your product arrives damaged, take a photo and report the issue within seven days. You can request a replacement or a refund. There is no extra charge for a replacement.

Repairs: if your product stops working in the first year, we can book a repair service at your home. Repairs from Monday to Friday are free. For a repair on Saturday, you need to pay an extra charge of £20.

Before the driver or repair person comes, we will call you to confirm the details. Please tell us when you are available. If possible, give us two times.

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Booking a repair
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: What is the problem?
The washing machine is ____ months old.
The repair is free.
Which two days can the repair person come?
The extra charge on Saturday is ____ pounds.
When is the customer available?
Her address is 12 ____ Street.
What does the agent do at the end?

script: Good afternoon, customer service. How can I help you?
Hello. I'm calling about my washing machine. There seems to be a problem with it. It doesn't start.
I'm sorry to hear that. How old is it?
OK. Then the repair is free. We can send a repair person on Tuesday or on Saturday.
Is there an extra charge on Saturday?
Yes, there's an extra charge of fifteen pounds on Saturday.
Then Tuesday, please. I'm available in the morning, if possible.
No problem. Could I have your address, please?
Thank you. Finally, let me confirm the details. A free repair on Tuesday morning at 12 Green Street.
Perfect. Thank you for your help!
